0.3.0.description: The Codex Automation recipe for scheduled self-review has been retired because Codex schedules share one default sandbox and cannot give the audit a schedule-specific Read Only boundary. Open Scheduled, find the recurring task whose prompt names the Engine self-review, pause or delete it, and confirm it is no longer Active. Run the audit in an ordinary interactive Read Only Codex task, or use the GitHub/Claude recurring review described in .engine/audits/self-review-setup.md.
